name: Calypsow
summary: Defensive tall fescue blend with strong disease depth and summer-stress focus.
buyHint: Heritage / specialty turf dealers. Ask for Calypsow by name.
notes: Published cultivar set. Unweighted when scoring unless bag percents are on your tag.

name: Resilience II
summary: Equal-part elite blend with strong transition-zone and appearance traits.
buyHint: Twin City Seed and dealers that stock TCS blends. 5–50 lb bags.
notes: 4th Millennium SRP may be missing from the 2018–2023 NTEP extract — absence is a data gap, not a quality judgment.

name: Optimum
summary: Four-way of A-LIST / Lateral Spread cultivars aimed at heat, traffic, and brown patch.
buyHint: Mountain View Seeds dealers and many SiteOne / pro shops. Confirm the current bag tag.
notes: From the Mountain View Optimum tech sheet. Bag percentages vary by lot.

name: Artimuss
summary: Equal-part MVS Lateral Spread cultivars sold as a named bag. Blue-tag certified, Gravity SL treated.
buyHint: lawnsynergy.com in 25 and 50 lb bags. Confirm the current tag — lots can shift a point or two.
notes: Published tag from Lawn Synergy. Remainder is inert matter, not filler seed.

name: Envy
summary: Three-way of NTEP-mapped tall fescues aimed at dark color, density, and brown patch.
buyHint: lawnsynergy.com in 10, 25, and 50 lb bags. Aimed at transition-zone lawns.
notes: Published Lawn Synergy cultivar list. Remainder is inert matter.

name: Kentucky 31
summary: The forage-type fescue still sold at box stores. Coarse, light green, and a useful NTEP check — not an elite lawn blend.
buyHint: Home Depot, Lowe’s, Ace, and farm co-ops. Compare elite blends against this, don’t start here if you want turf-type density.
notes: Included as the widely available baseline so ‘best for my zone’ has something cheap to beat.

name: Riviera Bermudagrass
summary: OSU-bred seeded bermuda sold as a named bag. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Hancock Seed, Seed Barn, and Johnston Seed when in stock.
notes: Single named cultivar. Crop shortages happen — confirm availability before you plan a full lawn.

name: Monaco Bermudagrass
summary: Johnston Seed / Barenbrug Monaco with Yellow Jacket coating. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Barenbrug distributors and Johnston Seed. Often sold coated.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial. Availability varies by season.

name: Copperhead Bermudagrass
summary: DLF Copperhead (DLF-460/3048) seeded bermuda. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: DLF wholesale / pro turf dealers. Ask for Copperhead by name.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial.

name: Sun Queen Bermudagrass
summary: Pure-Seed Testing seeded bermuda (PST-R6MM). In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Justin Seed and Atlas Turf dealers. Often sold coated as PureCoat+.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial.
